Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, S. J. MUKHOPADHAYA
CONSTITUTION OF IND/A, 1950: A B c Article 226 read with Article 136 - Limitation for filing of writ petition - Held: Though no period of limitation has been provided for filing a petition under Article 226, but one of the several rules of self-imposed restraint is may not enquire into a belated or stale claim and may deny D relief to the petitioner if he is found guilty of /aches - Further, during the intervening period, rights of third parties may have crystallized - Interference by Supreme Court in such matters would be warranted only if it is found
Decision Date : 29-09-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7588/2005 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
